sources.title: Workday Business Process Framework
sources.claim: Configurable event-triggered workflows, approval, documents, integrations and historical audit are product foundations.

sources.claim: Authorized work/status/deadline cards support widget-oriented Home; this does not dictate DWP's exact seven workbenches.

sources.title: SAP Integration Center
sources.claim: Configured file/API integrations may be run, scheduled and monitored in a common control surface.

sources.title: Oracle Talent Management
sources.claim: Recruiting, continuous performance, learning, skills, mobility and succession are legitimate adjacent capabilities, not universal mandatory first-release scope.

sources.title: Workday Responsible AI Practices
sources.claim: Human control, transparency, configuration, fairness testing and monitoring must bound AI-assisted HR actions.

findings.title: Domain identity and source lineage are not executable
findings.interpretation: 45 correlation→business reference rows are definite defects. 221 reference and 150 generic derivation rows require explicit entity-preserving source definitions. 413 missing physical response-source columns include legitimate derived page/receipt fields, but the declared table.column sources are not valid; derived projections must be named, typed and independently closed.

examples.requiredSource: request.offeringPublicId -> authorized published offering -> tenant-bound local ID
preserve loaded policy owner; actor is independent authenticated audit subject

findings.repair: Define entity-typed request references; parent-created local IDs; authenticated principal/worker mappings; preserved loaded aggregate relationships; named versioned provider refetch; typed query/receipt projections. Control headers must never become business object IDs.
findings.acceptance: Independent graph validator rejects wrong entity even when UUID types match, invented derived source, unresolved parent FK, omitted projection item field, and correlation copied to business reference.

findings.title: Real business payload cannot be persisted or reproducibly refetched

examples.missing: amount/currency have no declared persisted column or typed immutable artifact reference
question version and typed answers or exact immutable answer artifact/refetch contract
typed metric definition and result values/refetch; digest alone is not a definition
ordered proposed shift lines; candidate digest alone cannot be published as a schedule
proposal admission/update carrying worker/component/currency/amount before existing proposalId can be submitted

findings.repair: For every aggregate choose typed stored columns/child rows or an immutable artifact with exact schema/version/owner/ID/digest and tenant-purpose-projection-safe owner refetch. No digest-only mutation, generic businessKey substituted for domain intent, or child rows created without a child actor/target.
findings.acceptance: Round-trip all declared business inputs to persisted or refetched typed outputs, deterministically reproduce after process restart, and compare meaningful domain values rather than only hashes.

findings.title: Multiple business objects conflated into one lifecycle and entry/completion paths absent

examples.issue: not a physical stage enum; candidate admission missing; one requisition cannot share the lifecycle of N candidates
only ASSIGNED source prevents repeated task completion; COMPLETED never reached

findings.repair: Separate states of template/definition/version, assignment/application/case, decision/result/artifact. Define exact repeated child command edges and all entry/completion paths; required cancellation/rejection or explicitly unsupported scope must be declared. Retire/cancel paths not required in a deliberately bounded release may be P1/followup only after the contract stops claiming them.
findings.acceptance: Two children under one parent proceed independently, all terminal states are reachable or explicitly excluded, no pseudo state strings are persisted, forbidden edges are denied, and business events refer to entities that actually exist.

findings.title: Modern acceptance assertions lack concrete semantic synthetic fixtures
findings.repair: Define synthetic config A/B, concrete typed input, expected stored/refetched domain values, rows/events/receipt/error for happy/denied/duplicate/correction cases now. Actual implementation/test evidence remains G4; this finding does not require fake G4 PASS or real customer datasets.
findings.acceptance: Fixtures are machine-readable, typed against source contracts and independently assert semantic values, including config variation and downstream mock reconciliation.
